images.actual_source_analysis: A small unpainted wooden footbridge is viewed straight along its deck, with two curved side rails and capped near posts. Exactly two low black path lights stand at the near entrance, one left and one right, casting small warm pools onto dry gravel and mulch. A large tree trunk is at far left; leafy hostas and shrubs surround the bridge. A dark pond with a few lily pads, reeds and stone edging is visible behind and to the right, with one smaller distant garden light reflected at the far bank. Dense dark foliage fills the background, and the foreground gravel path is dry.
